address: Marina Bay Sands Hotel, Tower 2, Lobby, 10 Bayfront Avenue, 018972, Singapore
bio: This more accessible spinoff of its upscale sister Waku Ghin is the brainchild of the eponymous chef Tetsuya Wakuda. All rooms feature the traditional Japanese craft of wood joinery prominently, alongside soft lighting, tan leather chairs and banquettes. The menu offers an array of modern Japanese classics made with quality ingredients sourced globally. Adding original cocktails and a buzzy vibe to the equation, Wakuda guarantees a fun night out....
